draft.emotion: hurried and slightly breathless, with a sense of many tasks to finish
notes: Used to describe a person who has too much to do. It is often used to politely decline an invitation.
Do not confuse this with 'ασχολούμαι' (to be occupied with/to deal with), which is the verb form.

senses.definition: Having a lot of work or tasks to do; not having any free time.
